items.description: Earth's atmosphere offers protection from a nuclear blast in space, but satellites are more exposed. We explain how radiation could damage them, why the effects can linger and what protection is possible.

items.title: European court finds states can turn back migrants in some cases
items.description: Europe's top human rights court ruled that member states can turn back migrants unless they've been identified as people who were at risk of suffering.

items.title: EU imposes import quotas for hybrid vehicles from China
items.description: The EU is trying to protect its own car manufacturers from what it called "overcapacity" in China. Carmakers in the bloc, especially in Germany, have been lagging behind their Chinese rivals.
